title: How Far Apart Are Two Proofs? Measuring Proof Dissimilarity in a Proof Kernel and in Lean/Mathlib
abstract: arXiv:2611.31811v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We now live in the age of machine-generated mathematics: AI systems produce research-level proofs faster than the human mathematical community can read them. Verification is only part of the challenge. We also need to know whether a "new proof" is indeed new, whether a thousand generated proofs contain one idea or many, and where each sits relative to human mathematics. All of these require measuring distances between proofs. Following Hilbert's 24th problem and the identity-of-proofs problem, we ask how far apart two proofs of one theorem are, and what shape the proof space they inhabit has. We define 19 dissimilarity measures in 6 families (syntactic, structural, dependency & resource, semantic, information-theoretic, higher-categorical) and 10 desirable properties, which we argue are the conditions for safely optimising a measure. translated_title: 两个证明相距多远？在证明内核与 Lean/Mathlib 中度量证明差异性
translated_abstract: 我们如今生活在机器生成数学的时代：AI 系统产生研究级证明的速度已超过人类数学界能够阅读它们的速度。验证只是挑战的一部分，我们还需要知道一个“新证明”是否真的是新的，一千个生成的证明究竟包含一个想法还是多个想法，以及每个证明相对于人类数学所处的位置。所有这些都要求度量证明之间的距离。沿着希尔伯特第 24 问题与证明等同性问题的思路，我们追问：同一个定理的两个证明相距多远？它们所栖居的证明空间又具有怎样的形状？我们定义了 6 个族（句法、结构、依赖与资源、语义、信息论、高阶范畴）共 19 种差异性度量，以及 10 个期望性质，我们认为这些性质是安全优化某一度量的前提条件。在一个 Curry-Howard 内核中，5 个经机器验证的素数无穷性证明表明，原始句法……
tldr: 该论文针对“同一定理的两个证明相距多远”这一源于希尔伯特第 24 问题的基础问题，定义了 6 大族共 19 种证明差异性度量和 10 个期望性质，并在 Curry-Howard 内核与 Lean/Mathlib 中加以实例化与验证。
en_tdlr: This paper defines 19 proof dissimilarity measures across 6 families together with 10 desirable properties to answer how far apart two proofs of the same theorem are, instantiating them in a Curry-Howard kernel and in Lean/Mathlib.
